parameters.policy: inherit unchanged from authenticated M28C full-B0 template
parameters.smoother: XGBoost 100 trees, depth 4, learning rate 0.1, L2=1, L1=0

numerical_guard.policy: inherit exact tolerance and patched runtime known-answer from M28C r5; the negative-roundoff count is derived separately from each authenticated root B0 before training

gates.R0_CHAIN: Every persistent selection/materialization/ingest report and manifest belongs to the same root and production contract.
gates.R1_INPUTS: All VCF/TBI/map/sample-map/B0/config hashes are bound into one root runtime contract.
gates.R2_GUARD: The fixed numerical guard matches the r5 runtime and accepts the root-specific B0 map without material negative mass.
gates.R3_BOUNDARY: Training receives REF only; inference receives TARGET only; neither process has truth or mosaic inputs.
gates.R4_MODEL: The unchanged full-B0 Gnomix model trains, serializes and reloads under the root contract; process-tree peak RSS must not exceed 6.4 GiB.
gates.R5_PREDICTIONS: FB/MSP contain 30 targets, 371 windows, 79,791 markers and finite normalized AFR/EUR/ASIA probabilities.
gates.R6_BINDING: The final M29 binding authenticates FB/MSP, inference report/manifest, runtime contract and run provenance for the exact root.

stop_rule: Stop the affected root on any hash, contract, numerical, model, inference or binding failure. Never substitute historical M28C predictions or open truth.
